title: George Harrison and Ringo Starr attend Hollywood party | 1973
content:
George Harrison and Ringo Starr attended a Hollywood party on 14 April 1973.

It was arranged by talent agent Sue Mengers to celebrate the 27 March win at the Academy Awards for Best Documentary Feature for Marjoe, about religious evangelist Marjoe Gartner.

John Lennon and Yoko Ono were invited but did not attend as they had returned to New York City earlier in the day. Lennon penned a handwritten note of apology to the film’s co-producer Howard Smith.

Sat Morning Dawn

Dear Howard,

Something came up in N.Y… we had to go…

Sorry if it f****d you ’round – we’ll make it up.

Hope your not upset – give our love to Peter & Betsy. Please tell them we were too HASSLED with lousiness to call them back. We might be back sooner than we thing (to L.A.) – if not see you in the BIG apple.

Love from John&Yoko
